articles.title: Somalia Expands Regional Trade & Infrastructure Initiatives
articles.summary: New commercial and infrastructural agreements aim to boost maritime trade, digital financial platforms, and regional connectivity across East Africa.
articles.content: Somalia continues its strategic development roadmap focusing on economic resilience, digital transaction infrastructure, and regional trade integration.

articles.title: Global Somali Diaspora Innovation Hub Expands Digital Investment
articles.summary: Delegates gathered to discuss cross-border investment, venture funding, renewable energy initiatives, and diaspora-backed educational technology.
articles.content: Entrepreneurs and community leaders from North America and Europe highlighted new venture capital initiatives focused on tech and economic development.
